ROOM OF DAYS · LISTENING STUDY · 2026-08-27

The Answered Detent

"the completion isnt as satisfying" -- five takes on the completion gesture, level-matched so loudness can't win. all keep the permanence grammar: the accepted contact, then the answer 75 ms later. IN CONTEXT plays two everyday taps first, then the completion, the way it lands on the board.

AS SHIPPED

the completion on your phone today (build 33 and earlier) -- rendered before the render-polish pass existed.

POLISHED, AS SHIPPED

the exact same gesture under the 08-21 polish discipline: quieter noise beds, subliminal room. if the old one reads 'low quality recording', this isolates it.

DEEPER SEAT

polish plus a heavier two-part accepted seat and a denser root. fuller through body, not volume.

WEIGHTED ANSWER

polish plus the answer arriving with its own small catch, like a latch truly seating.

LONGER SETTLE

polish with a longer believable ring -- the same voices given room to settle.

phone speaker, as always. the verdict slot is design/audits/2026-08-27/room-completion-voice-v2/LISTENING-RESULT.md -- "keep as shipped" counts too.
